messages:
Jess: quick q — i hit a flaky client test around 429s for per-route burst. what headers/body should clients rely on during the rollout?
Sam: include backwards-compatible headers for a transition window. keep Retry-After + existing X-RateLimit-* while emitting the new names.
Khoa: runtime note: we can emit both header names, but need to avoid doubling semantics (keep values consistent). Retry-After should always be present when we want clients to wait.
Laura: SDK note: current logic checks `Retry-After` -> `X-RateLimit-Reset` -> body.retry_after_ms. we can extend to check the new X-RW-Route-Bucket header. will add a parser hook.
Jess: example 429 blob that reproduced the failure: 
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Retry-After: 2
X-RW-Quota-Bucket: chat/completions/v1/route-123
X-RW-Burst-Allowance: 0
Content-Type: application/json

{"error":{"type":"rate_limit","retry_after_ms":2000,"bucket":"chat/completions/v1/route-123"}}
```
Sam: thanks. proposal: standardize on `X-RW-Route-Bucket` and `X-RW-Burst-Remaining` (more explicit). deprecate `X-RW-Quota-Bucket` and `X-RW-Burst-Allowance` after 6 weeks.
Khoa: runtime will emit both names during the deprecation window. also we'll keep `X-RateLimit-Remaining` for proxy compatibility.
Laura: SDKs will accept both header variants and prefer the new names when present. i'll add unit tests to cover: header-only, body-only, both.
Jess: curious about client behaviour for soft 429s vs hard 429s — do we want a body flag?
Sam: yes, add `soft: true` to the JSON body for soft-degrade 429s (clients may choose to retry with degraded params). hard 429s omit the flag.
Khoa: runtime will set `soft` when the quota policy is a soft-burst fallback. we'll also emit `X-RW-Soft: 1` header for quick checks by edge proxies.
Laura: noted. i'll implement parsing for `soft` + `X-RW-Soft` and wire integration tests.
Jess: can someone open a checklist issue capturing: headers to emit (old+new), body schema, SDK parsing rules, doc migration note, deprecation timeline?
deploy-bot: Created issue #4821: "rl: harmonize headers (X-RW-Route-Bucket) + sdk tests" — https://go/redwood/4821
Laura: i'll add the SDK PR and tests, will ping here once ready.
Khoa: scheduling runtime changes for a canary tomorrow morning, ETA EOD Friday for global roll.
Sam: i'll update the API docs + changelog and include an example 429 with both headers + body.
Jess: awesome — thanks everyone :thumbsup:
